title: The Politics of Poland’s Judicial Crisis
gist: Maciej Kisilowski argues that the removal of Bogdan Święczkowski as president of Poland's Constitutional Tribunal, which sparked a physical confrontation and a standoff between Donald Tusk's government and PiS, was legitimate because he held the post illegally. He says asking whether democrats must break the law to restore sabotaged institutions is the wrong question in Poland's case.

insights.claim: The removal of Bogdan Święczkowski as president of Poland's Constitutional Tribunal has triggered a physical confrontation at the court and a political standoff between Donald Tusk's government and the Law and Justice (PiS) party.
insights.speaker: @kisilowski
insights.so_what: Escalating institutional conflict raises Polish political risk and could weigh on EU relations and rule-of-law assessments.
